method: candidate lines proposed by corridor detection; identity decided from printed address runs and street-name labels
why_not_one_block_off: Sheet 81 covers Q/Q 1/2/R/R 1/2 and sheet 82 covers R 1/2/S/S 1/2/T, so Ave R 1/2 is the only shared corridor; both plates print 'AVENUE R 1/2' in this gutter (twice each, in the 36th-37th and 38th-39th bands) and each prints the other's number beside it ('82' on sheet 81, '81' on sheet 82). The cross-street run changes hundred-block exactly here: sheet 81's block west of the avenue reads 2315/2317/2319/2321/2323/2325 with evens 2316/2318/2320/2322/2324; sheet 82's block east of it reads 2401/2403/2405/2407/2409 with 2402/2404/2406/2408/2410. One corridor west on sheet 81 the change is 21xx->22xx at Ave Q 1/2 (2123 west, 2201/2203/2205 east; faces 1040/1254) and 22xx->23xx at Ave R (2221/2223 west, 2301/2303/2305 east; faces 2048/2260). The avenue frontage runs interlock: sheet 81's east block face carries evens 3602,3604,3606...3628 and sheet 82's west block face the odds 3601,3603,3605...3627, the two sides of the same 36th-37th segment.
note: Detection candidates (81: 740/1750/2760; 82: 2596/1586/576) are mid-block lines. '70'' is printed mid-avenue on both plates - native x 3154 on sheet 81, native x 171 on sheet 82 - and matches the face-derived centres (sheet 81 west face 3041 + 105 = 3146; sheet 82 east face 278 - 105 = 173); 3150 / 172 recorded. Avenue width 70' confirmed on both plates from Ave Q 1/2 (214 px) and Ave R (212 px) on sheet 81 and Ave S (208 px) on sheet 82. CAUTION: over native y ~1500-2400 the 'Negro Recreation Park' block (SE 135) is drafted straight across this right-of-way on both plates, so the corridor has no faces in that band; both readings were taken in the 36th-37th band above it. Avenue-to-avenue pitch on sheet 81 is ~1005 px (Q 148, Q 1/2 1147, R 2154), consistent with R 1/2 at ~3155.
